milestone: 2B documentation-filter held-out validation (EXPERIMENTAL; not an official ARB score)
framework: Phase 1 product-aligned evaluation: file unit, whole-file input, full ranking; packed context separate
treatment: AblationConfig(enable_doc_filter=True, doc_filter_penalty=p) passed per call to retrieve()
control: AblationConfig() (enable_doc_filter=False) passed per call to retrieve()
doc_predicate: engine.py legacy ranker: path contains /doc/, /docs/, doc/, docs/, documentation/, guide/, tutorial/, .github/ OR ends with .md, .rst, .txt, .adoc, .html (case-insensitive)

split.algorithm: For attempt a = 0, 1, ...: shuffle the sorted repository list with random.Random(f'{seed}:{a}'); test = first 10. Accept the first attempt where, for every task with n repositories, the test count is within +-1 of round(0.4*n) and both splits contain >= 1 repository with that task.
split.inputs_used: repository ids and task coverage (presence of >=1 gold-labelled query per task) only

primary.contrast: filter ON - filter OFF on TEST repositories
primary.success: paired repository-clustered 95% percentile CI lower bound > 0

guardrails.test: one-sided regression test: bootstrap p = (1 + #{resampled mean diff >= 0}) / (B + 1)
guardrails.correction: Holm-Bonferroni over the 7 guardrail hypotheses, family-wise alpha = 0.05
guardrails.note: Recall@5 and Recall@10 for every task are reported with uncorrected CIs (descriptive)

dev_selection_rule: Among grid values whose DEV mean (ON - OFF) for comment2context MRR and for MRR and Recall@20 of every other task is >= -0.02, choose the one maximising DEV mean comment2context Recall@20 gain, provided it is > 0; ties -> larger penalty (milder). If none qualifies, freeze the existing default penalty 0.5 and record the dev failure.

decision_rule.VALIDATED: primary CI lower bound > 0 AND no Holm-supported guardrail regression
decision_rule.NOT VALIDATED: any Holm-supported guardrail regression, OR primary point estimate <= 0
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: no Holm-supported regression, primary point estimate > 0, but primary CI includes 0; or fewer than 5 test repositories contain comment2context queries
